from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial line item extracted from a single document's financial statements."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant's name as stated in the document")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact text label of the balance sheet line item")
    amount_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric magnitude of the amount reported")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale unit of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars', 'millions')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
